analysis:
The supplied units are base_text excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (base lines 861-1713). They contain no patch hunks or head text, so the actual changed lines are not visible and no PR-introduced behavior can be identified.

The documentation covers several security-relevant areas:
- doctor/verify diagnostics (961-994).
- report upload: under sudo it reads the user's auth_token via AuthTokenStore.loadReadOnly (1443-1448); devicecheck evidence is redacted (1430-1437). Relates to T-058 and A-008.
- logout: local completion is not remote invalidation (1329-1331). Relates to T-053 and A-008.
- Prefix-cache defaults (1609-1617): DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE is default-on for named models. SSD disk-budget and write-budget variables are forwarded to the LaunchAgent (1622-1629). Relates to T-041 and SEC-035.
- The App Attest worker-qualification passthrough is accepted only when the value is exactly 1 (1659-1663). Relates to TB-011 and T-052.
- The fan helper requires a lease and an explicit sudo (1311-1317). Relates to TB-010.
- Path and keychain identifiers (1466-1490), including the KEK service, SE key label and Team ID.

All of this text is consistent with the canonical T-041 description: 30-minute TTL, kill switch, and cacheSalt scoping that is coordinator-authored and not enabled by any CLI setting.

The next pass should examine the actual diff hunks for this file. Watch for:
- new passthrough environment keys, especially any App Attest or fault-injection flags forwarded to the daemon;
- changes to prefix-cache defaults or TTL claims;
- logout or report token-handling semantics;
- any wording that overclaims attestation or qualification (T-052, T-056).
